definitions.explanation: A compact umbrella that can be folded down for easy carrying in a bag. A common everyday item in Japan, where sudden rain is frequent.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}を{持|も}ってきた。
カバンにいつも{折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: I always keep a folding umbrella in my bag.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}な{雨|あめ}に{備|そな}えて、{軽|かる}い{折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}を{一本|いっぽん}は{常備|じょうび}しておくとよい。
examples.english: It's good to always have a lightweight folding umbrella on hand in case of sudden rain.

notes:
An essential everyday item in Japan. Many people carry one year-round due to Japan's frequent and often unpredictable rainfall. Japanese folding umbrellas are known for being exceptionally compact and lightweight.

FORMS:
{折|お}り{畳|たた}み (folding) + {傘|かさ} (umbrella; voiced to がさ in compound)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}を{開|ひら}く: to open a folding umbrella
- {折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}を{畳|たた}む: to fold up an umbrella
- {軽量|けいりょう}{折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}: lightweight folding umbrella
- {自動開閉|じどうかいへい}{折|お}り{畳|たた}み{傘|がさ}: auto-open-close folding umbrella

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {傘|かさ}: umbrella — general term, usually refers to a full-sized umbrella
- {日傘|ひがさ}: parasol — an umbrella for sun protection, not rain
- ビニール{傘|がさ}: clear plastic umbrella — cheap, disposable umbrellas sold at convenience stores
